Instead, written in faded indigo ink, were four simple words: 'Keep the light burning.'", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市浸在铅蓝色的寂静中，白日喧嚣的车流退去，只剩环卫工人的橙色背心在昏黄路灯下缓缓移动。便利店亮着孤岛般的白光，热气在玻璃窗上凝结成雾。高楼轮廓模糊地切入夜空，偶尔有一两扇窗亮起微光，不知是早起赶路的人，还是整夜未眠的灵魂。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a rule or task solves a big problem by repeating itself on a smaller piece of that same problem.\n- Imagine looking into two mirrors facing each other: you see smaller and smaller copies of yourself stretching out forever.\n- To keep it from going on without stopping, every recursive task must have an ending rule that tells it when to quit."}
